origin.details: Begin and end positions are stored on the tokenizer.
origin.value: The same value readr 2.2.0 returns for this case, written as one line in the output.
origin.example:
token <- tokenizer_fwf(c(0, 5), c(4, 10))
paste(paste(token$begin, collapse = ","), paste(token$end, collapse = ","), sep = ";")

translation.description: Begin and end positions are stored on the tokenizer.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The data, path, or collector this function accepts.

translation.details: Begin and end positions are stored on the tokenizer.
translation.value: The same value readr 2.2.0 returns for this case, written as one line in the output.
translation.example:
token = tokenizer_fwf([0, 5], [4, 10])
return ",".join(str(value) for value in token["begin"]) + ";" + ",".join(str(value) for value in token["end"])
